gate3.note: This is a default-off paper candidate-pool admission rule, not a core production filter.

gate4.rationale: The no-core-flow displacement field did not beat the accepted FTD+FINRA comparator. The likely failure is that same-day core-flow presence is not a reliable crowding proxy here; excluding those dates removes some valid settlement/borrow-pressure winners without creating enough independent replacement value.
